CURRENT QUESTION:
top 5 kids who improved the most in situps from baseline to endline
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH baseline_situps AS (
    SELECT
        "Child ID",
        "Child Name",
        "Location",
        "Gender",
        "Age",
        "Sit Ups" AS baseline_situps
    FROM "sportathon_baseline"
),
endline_situps AS (
    SELECT
        "Child ID",
        "Child Name",
        "Location",
        "Gender",
        "Age",
        "Sit Ups" AS endline_situps
    FROM "sportathon_endline"
),
improvement AS (
    SELECT
        b."Child ID",
        b."Child Name",
        b."Location",
        b."Gender",
        b."Age",
        e.endline_situps - b.baseline_situps AS situps_improvement
    FROM baseline_situps b
    JOIN endline_situps e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
)
SELECT
    "Child ID",
    "Child Name",
    "Location",
    "Gender",
    "Age",
    situps_improvement
FROM improvement
WHERE situps_improvement > 0
ORDER BY situps_improvement DESC
LIMIT 5
```
